targets.rawSql: SELECT 'e2e' AS "Mode",p.site_key AS "Site Key",p.site_name AS "Data Center",p.router AS "WAN Router",p.firewall AS "Firewall",p.l3_switch AS "L3 Switch",a.switch_name AS "Access Switch",a.switch_interface AS "Switch Interface",p.server_name AS "Server",a.server_interface AS "Server Interface",coalesce(p.vm_name,'Physical workload') AS "Virtual Machine",p.pod_name AS "Pod",p.application_name AS "Application",p.business_service AS "Business Service",initcap(replace(p.path_status,'_',' ')) AS "Path Health" FROM inventory.end_to_end_connectivity_paths p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT switch_name,switch_interface,server_interface FROM inventory.server_network_attachment_overview x WHERE x.server_key=p.server_key ORDER BY CASE x.redundancy_role WHEN 'primary' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1) a ON true WHERE p.site_key='${site:raw}' ORDER BY CASE p.path_status WHEN 'at_risk' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,p.business_service,p.application_name,p.pod_name

list.definition: SELECT name AS __text,site_key AS __value FROM inventory.sites ORDER BY name
